# Table

Rows and columns of comparable records, with headers.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-table--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Table examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-table--docs">Open Table in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-table--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** A customer's own records in the account area, such as Your subscriptions, in comfortable rows. Not as a tool for bulk work.

- **Use it when:** Records people scan, sort or compare cell by cell.
- **Not when:** A grid of teasers (cards), or the shape of a relationship (chart).

Instead:

- [Data table](./data-table.md): Many records with search, filters and paging.
- [Chart](./chart.md): The shape of the numbers.

## How Multi-brand uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A number in a table</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> type.body</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A mono font</div></div><div class="cap">Numbers read like text in every brand.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A selected row or item</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> color.surface.selected (from the brand)</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A fixed blue</div></div><div class="cap">Selection follows the brand color.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Table row height</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> size.row (comfortable)</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A compact row</div></div><div class="cap">Comfortable rows in every brand.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It has a caption and header cells, so each cell is read with its header. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add table
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Table reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.
